thes_hear_home.label: Hear a hoped-for return
thes_hear_home.meaning: To take an ordinary sound, for the space of a heartbeat, for evidence that someone long awaited has come back. The recognition can outlive one's knowledge that it is impossible
thes_hear_home.nativeAnalysis: long:m wait:ev make:pr other sound loved:m person:g return seem:inf
thes_hear_home.exampleAnalysis: when gate next door close:pa i my/sister:a @:pa. her/ship still at sea be:pa.
thes_hear_home.exampleEnglish: When the gate next door shut, I heard my sister coming home. Her ship was still at sea.
thes_hear_home.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_wait_face.label: Wait for the face
thes_wait_face.meaning: To wait for the one detail that would make public good news true for oneself. The larger event has already been confirmed
thes_wait_face.nativeAnalysis: good:m news for all already know:psv:pr but still for sign of own:m loved:m person wait:inf
thes_wait_face.exampleAnalysis: town bell sound:pa for return of ship. at gate father still @:pa until last child from ship descend:pa.
thes_wait_face.exampleEnglish: The town bell rang for the ship’s return. At the gate Father was still waiting as the last child stepped down.
thes_wait_face.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_release_watch.label: Wait in another's stead
thes_release_watch.meaning: To take over someone’s waiting with a promise to call them at the first change. The promise releases the other person to sleep or leave
thes_release_watch.nativeAnalysis: for other wait:inf and at first change other call:inf promise:inf so other leave:can:pr
thes_release_watch.exampleAnalysis: go:imp and sleep:imp. i @:fu. before i gate open:fu thou his/name hear:fu.
thes_release_watch.exampleEnglish: Go to sleep. I’ll wait for you. You’ll hear his name before I open the gate.
thes_release_watch.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_twofold_absence.label: The burden carried home
thes_twofold_absence.meaning: The grief peculiar to doing a familiar task alone for the first time after a lasting parting. Its onset belongs to the work resuming
thes_twofold_absence.nativeAnalysis: sorrow when after long:m separation person first time alone do:pr work which before both together do:pa
thes_twofold_absence.exampleAnalysis: at wharf_landing she smile:pa. only when she both oar_implement:pl lift:pa @ come:pa.
thes_twofold_absence.exampleEnglish: She smiled at the quay. It was only when she lifted both oars that the grief came over her.
thes_twofold_absence.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_miss_own_self.label: Loss of a self held in company
thes_miss_own_self.meaning: Longing for the particular person one could be in someone else's presence. One can feel it while fully consenting to the separation
thes_miss_own_self.nativeAnalysis: after other depart:pr desire for self which with other alone live:pa
thes_miss_own_self.exampleAnalysis: for my/master i kjv_yearn:neg:pa. my/@ for child who with he every question ask:can:pa be:pa.
thes_miss_own_self.exampleEnglish: I did not miss my master. I missed the child I could be with him, the one who could ask anything.
thes_miss_own_self.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_joy_recipient.label: Joy that still finds its hearer
thes_joy_recipient.meaning: Joy sharpened by knowing exactly who would have shared it, when that person can no longer be told
thes_joy_recipient.nativeAnalysis: joy when know:pr who such:m tale most love:pa and with he again speak:neg:can:pr
thes_joy_recipient.exampleAnalysis: kjv_goat his/hat eat:pa. with @ she laugh:pa. her/brother such:m tale most love:pa. year:pl before he die:pp.
thes_joy_recipient.exampleEnglish: When the goat ate his hat, she laughed with the joy of knowing exactly who would have loved the story. Her brother had been dead for years.
thes_joy_recipient.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_maker_envy.label: Envy that wants the work to stand
thes_maker_envy.meaning: The pain of wanting another maker's skill while wholeheartedly wanting the particular thing they made to survive. One can act in the work’s favour while still feeling it
thes_maker_envy.nativeAnalysis: other:g skill desire:inf with pain and other:g work with joy keep:inf
thes_maker_envy.exampleAnalysis: in @ i my/rival:g cup from fire save:pa. still i wish:pa that my/hand it make:pp.
thes_maker_envy.exampleEnglish: It was envy that made me wish my hands had shaped my rival’s cup, and love of that same cup that made me pull it from the fire.
thes_maker_envy.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_angry_wait.label: Anger that keeps vigil
thes_angry_wait.meaning: Anger at someone for taking a risk, sustained alongside the fear that the risk may have cost them their life. A safe return can release the quarrel
thes_angry_wait.nativeAnalysis: anger at other who danger choose:pa while for other:g safety wait:pr
thes_angry_wait.exampleAnalysis: all night in her/@ she lamp bright:m keep:pa. when he return:pa at last she he:a scold:can:pa.
thes_angry_wait.exampleEnglish: Her anger kept the lamp burning all night. Only when he was safely home could she finally tell him off.
thes_angry_wait.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_private_gift.label: Give with the right to remain unseen
thes_private_gift.meaning: To give in a way that lets the recipient accept without having to appear, explain their need, or host the giver. The recipient may know exactly who gave it
thes_private_gift.nativeAnalysis: give:inf so other accept:can:pr without face show:inf or word give:inf
thes_private_gift.exampleAnalysis: she kjv_broth at door @:pa and child:pl away lead:pa before widow from bed rise:pa.
thes_private_gift.exampleEnglish: She left the soup where the widow could reach it and led the children away before the widow had to get up.
thes_private_gift.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_leave_spare.label: Provide an unnamed place
thes_leave_spare.meaning: To provide for an unknown future participant before anyone must identify themselves as the one in need
thes_leave_spare.nativeAnalysis: for person still unknown:m share keep:inf before help ask:psv:pr
thes_leave_spare.exampleAnalysis: before dam_passenger:pl come:pa for each voyage they for one_num more person room @:pa. no purse open:must:pa.
thes_leave_spare.exampleEnglish: Before the passengers came, they made room on every crossing for one unnamed rider. Nobody had to open a purse.
thes_leave_spare.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_keep_choice.label: Give someone back a choice within care
thes_keep_choice.meaning: To meet a real need while returning one consequential decision to the person receiving help. The offered choices must actually be available
thes_keep_choice.nativeAnalysis: in need help give:inf and one_num true:m choice to person who help receive:pr give:inf
thes_keep_choice.exampleAnalysis: sick:m man house leave:neg:can:pa. wepl he:d @:pa. which guest first enter:fu he choose:pa.
thes_keep_choice.exampleEnglish: He was too ill to leave. We put one part of the visit back in his hands, and he chose which guest came in first.
thes_keep_choice.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_friend_disagrees.label: Friend who holds the other bank
thes_friend_disagrees.meaning: A friend whose loyalty shows in preserving one's freedom to persist in a disagreement. A person who merely withholds an opinion does not qualify
thes_friend_disagrees.nativeAnalysis: friend who own:m judgment speak:pr and other:g liberty to choose:inf protect:pr
thes_friend_disagrees.exampleAnalysis: my/@ against my/voyage speak:pa. before kjv_dawn to my/boat into water push:inf first come:pa.
thes_friend_disagrees.exampleEnglish: The friend who thought the voyage a mistake was the first one down at dawn to help me launch.
thes_friend_disagrees.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_welcome_changed.label: Offer continuity on the returner's terms
thes_welcome_changed.meaning: To offer a familiar kindness to someone who has changed, in a form they can decline without forfeiting their welcome
thes_welcome_changed.nativeAnalysis: old:m gift to person who return:perf again offer:inf and right to refuse:inf give:inf
thes_welcome_changed.exampleAnalysis: mother old:m cup @:pa. when i other cup choose:pa she it fill:pa and sit:pa near i.
thes_welcome_changed.exampleEnglish: Mother offered me my old cup. When I chose another, she filled that one and sat down beside me.
thes_welcome_changed.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_mercy_ordinary.label: Mercy through restored ordinariness
thes_mercy_ordinary.meaning: The kindness of giving a publicly embarrassed person an ordinary part in the next exchange, so that they need neither perform contrition nor receive conspicuous comfort
thes_mercy_ordinary.nativeAnalysis: after shame ordinary:m work to person give:inf so among other:pl again stand:can:pr
thes_mercy_ordinary.exampleAnalysis: after child bowl drop:pa his/aunt:g @ be:pa to ask he for bread as always.
thes_mercy_ordinary.exampleEnglish: After he dropped the bowl, his aunt’s kindness was to ask him for the bread just as she always did.
thes_mercy_ordinary.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_compassion_anticipation.label: Company for the approach
thes_compassion_anticipation.meaning: Fellow feeling directed specifically towards the lonely interval before a known ordeal. It can end at the threshold by mutual agreement
thes_compassion_anticipation.nativeAnalysis: with other before hard:m event remain:inf when other alone go:must:pr
thes_compassion_anticipation.exampleAnalysis: by @ his/sister to judge:ag:g door with he go:pa. there she his/hand loose:pa.
thes_compassion_anticipation.exampleEnglish: His sister gave him company for the walk to the judge’s door. There she let go of his hand.
thes_compassion_anticipation.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_agree_absent.label: Count someone in by their absence
thes_agree_absent.meaning: To grant supposed assent on behalf of someone who had no occasion to speak. The word identifies who took that liberty
thes_agree_absent.nativeAnalysis: for absent:m person yes say:inf when absent:m person answer give:neg:can:pa
thes_agree_absent.exampleAnalysis: while fisherman_net_worker:pl at sea be:pa council in their/name new:m toll:a @:pa.
thes_agree_absent.exampleEnglish: While the fishers were at sea the council counted them as consenting to the new toll.
thes_agree_absent.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_ask_in_passing.label: Ask on a journey already owed
thes_ask_in_passing.meaning: To send a question along an errand that will happen anyway, accepting the carrier’s own time for the answer. Demanding a special return changes the act
thes_ask_in_passing.nativeAnalysis: by other:g own:m journey ask:inf and time of answer to other leave:inf
thes_ask_in_passing.exampleAnalysis: when she to market go:pa i @:pa whether blue:m thread remain:pa. next market day she answer:pa.
thes_ask_in_passing.exampleEnglish: Since she was going to market anyway, I asked if there was blue thread left. She told me on the next market day.
thes_ask_in_passing.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_quiet_noise.label: Speak under cover of a common sound
thes_quiet_noise.meaning: To time one's words to a sound shared by listeners and bystanders, so that a chosen listener alone can make them out. An ordinary speaking voice can suffice
thes_quiet_noise.nativeAnalysis: while sound other ear:pl fill:pr to one_num person speak:inf so other:pl word:pl hear:neg:can:pr
thes_quiet_noise.exampleAnalysis: while bell sound:pa mother in my/ear @:pa. sell:ag ourone/face:pl see:pa but price hear:neg:pa.
thes_quiet_noise.exampleEnglish: Mother told me her price under cover of the bell. The seller was looking straight at us and never heard the figure.
thes_quiet_noise.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_witness_agreement.label: A dissenting trace
thes_witness_agreement.meaning: A material trace that contradicts what all available human witnesses agree happened. Its force comes from that disagreement and need not settle the whole account
thes_witness_agreement.nativeAnalysis: mark which against account of all witness:pl stand:pr
thes_witness_agreement.exampleAnalysis: all say:pa gate shut:m remain:pp. wet:m footprint on kjv_inner:m stair_step @ be:pa.
thes_witness_agreement.exampleEnglish: Everyone said the gate had stayed shut. The wet footprint on the inside stair was the one dissenting witness.
thes_witness_agreement.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_search_trace.label: Evidence made by the search
thes_search_trace.meaning: A real mark produced by the act of investigation and liable to be counted as evidence of the earlier event. Discovering its origin changes what it can prove
thes_search_trace.nativeAnalysis: mark from search itself which as sign of former:m event take:can:psv:pr
thes_search_trace.exampleAnalysis: black:m line on cloth @ be:pa. before cloth open:pa ourone/finger lamp touch:pp.
thes_search_trace.exampleEnglish: The black streak on the cloth was our own search trace. We had handled the lamp before unfolding it.
thes_search_trace.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_surviving_limit.label: A claim with a known edge
thes_surviving_limit.meaning: The narrower claim one can responsibly retain after a test has broken the broader one. It carries the exclusion the test established
thes_surviving_limit.nativeAnalysis: thought which after trial true:m remain:pr only within known:m boundary
thes_surviving_limit.exampleAnalysis: first they say:pa every thread shrink:pr. after test their/@ only of wet:m linen true:m remain:pa.
thes_surviving_limit.exampleEnglish: They had said that every thread shrank. What survived the trial applied only to wet linen.
thes_surviving_limit.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_test_against.label: Test at the point of possible failure
thes_test_against.meaning: To choose a further case because it could break a pattern already observed. Another easy confirmation would serve a different purpose
thes_test_against.nativeAnalysis: after same:m result choose:inf trial where result fail:can:pr
thes_test_against.exampleAnalysis: both dry:m kjv_cord:pl hold:pp. to @:inf her/locke_hypothesis she third kjv_cord in water put:pa.
thes_test_against.exampleEnglish: Both dry cords had held. To try her claim where it might give way, she soaked the third.
thes_test_against.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_fresh_guide.label: Steer through an overlap
thes_fresh_guide.meaning: To transfer guidance from one reliable mark to another while both can still be checked against each other. Knowing two marks in succession is insufficient
thes_fresh_guide.nativeAnalysis: while both mark:pl visible:m be:pr second by first test:inf and by second steer_course:inf
thes_fresh_guide.exampleAnalysis: before star behind hill go:pa she @:pa. by star still visible:m she harbour:g lamp below it test:pa.
thes_fresh_guide.exampleEnglish: Before the star went behind the hill she took up the harbour light, checking its bearing while the star still shone.
thes_fresh_guide.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_held_rhythm.label: Hold a course by a surviving rhythm
thes_held_rhythm.meaning: To maintain an established course through loss of sight by attending to the direction of a recurring movement against the hull
thes_held_rhythm.nativeAnalysis: when by eye way see:neg:can:pr by return:ev of wave against ship steer_course:inf
thes_held_rhythm.exampleAnalysis: in fog wepl sail see:neg:can:pa. by wave on left side sea_pilot @:pa until light return:pa.
thes_held_rhythm.exampleEnglish: In the fog we could not see the sail. The pilot held our course by the swell on our left until the light returned.
thes_held_rhythm.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_wrong_still.label: Judge motion by a borrowed stillness
thes_wrong_still.meaning: To read a relative change backwards because one takes one's own moving position as fixed. It also applies when a person's standard has shifted unnoticed
thes_wrong_still.nativeAnalysis: own:m change see:neg:inf and judge:inf that other change:perf
thes_wrong_still.exampleAnalysis: after year among singer:pl i @:pa that my/brother:g voice more weak:m become:pp. his/voice same:m remain:pp. my/ear change:pp.
thes_wrong_still.exampleEnglish: After a year among singers I took my brother’s voice for weaker. His voice was the same. My ear had moved.
thes_wrong_still.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_sized_view.label: Take the opening for the whole
thes_sized_view.meaning: To read a speaker’s limits of time, audience or means as limits on what they know or feel. It takes evidence about expression as evidence about its source
thes_sized_view.nativeAnalysis: few:m word:pl hear:inf and by their/measure speak:ag:g knowledge or love judge:inf
thes_sized_view.exampleAnalysis: one_num line in letter she @:pa as little:m love. only one_num line on book_leaf remain:pp.
thes_sized_view.exampleEnglish: She read the single line as scant affection. It was all the room the writer had left on the page.
thes_sized_view.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_coupled_fault.label: A fault that answers elsewhere
thes_coupled_fault.meaning: A fault identifiable as the common cause of two apparent failures because correcting it changes both. Co-occurrence alone does not establish the relation
thes_coupled_fault.nativeAnalysis: one_num fault from which two trouble:pl come:pr and by whose repair both cease:pr
thes_coupled_fault.exampleAnalysis: both door:pl close:neg:pa. @ loose:m stone be:pa: when it raise:psv:pa both close:pa.
thes_coupled_fault.exampleEnglish: Neither door would close. The loose stone was the fault they shared. When it was raised, both swung shut.
thes_coupled_fault.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_strain_mend.label: Mend to the strain
thes_strain_mend.meaning: To change the distribution of a load in the course of mending its damage. Closing the visible tear is only part of the job
thes_strain_mend.nativeAnalysis: torn:m cloth or wood mend:inf and weight to strong:m part:pl lead:inf
thes_strain_mend.exampleAnalysis: after third rend:ev she sail:a @:pa. now two edge:pl pull:ev share:pr.
thes_strain_mend.exampleEnglish: After the third tear she mended the sail to the strain. Both edges now take the pull.
thes_strain_mend.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_quiet_defect.label: Mend away the warning
thes_quiet_defect.meaning: To make a failing thing seem serviceable by removing the very sign that lets people notice its fault. The quieter result is part of the danger
thes_quiet_defect.nativeAnalysis: sign of fault remove:inf while cause remain:pr so fault hidden:m become:pr
thes_quiet_defect.exampleAnalysis: he door:a @:pa. kjv_hinge again loose:m become:pa but now sound make:neg:pa.
thes_quiet_defect.exampleEnglish: He silenced the door with his repair. The hinge still worked loose, only now we couldn't hear it.
thes_quiet_defect.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_learner_margin.label: Give a learner room for a real mistake
thes_learner_margin.meaning: To give a learner enough material or time to make a genuine mistake and correct it in the same work. The learner still bears the task of seeing what went wrong
thes_learner_margin.nativeAnalysis: for pupil_student enough:m wood or time leave:inf so after own:m error same:m work mend:can:pr
thes_learner_margin.exampleAnalysis: on first plank_board make:ag i:d @:pa. when i line pass:pa enough:m wood for second cut remain:pa.
thes_learner_margin.exampleEnglish: The maker left me a finger of spare wood on my first board. When I cut past the line, I still had enough to square the end myself.
thes_learner_margin.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_learn_release.label: Learn the handover
thes_learn_release.meaning: To acquire a movement at the instant a helper ceases to supply it, and to recognize that one is now carrying it oneself
thes_learn_release.nativeAnalysis: movement learn:inf when other:g hand cease:pr to help:inf and own:m hand same:m movement alone keep:pr
thes_learn_release.exampleAnalysis: when his/thumb_digit away go:pa i first knot:a @:pa. next kjv_loop same:m breadth remain:pa.
thes_learn_release.exampleEnglish: I learned the knot at the lift of his thumb. My next loop held the same width without him.
thes_learn_release.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_learn_last.label: Know a correction ahead of one's hands
thes_learn_last.meaning: To reach the stage of learning at which one can diagnose and explain one's own mistake yet still repeats it in action
thes_learn_last.nativeAnalysis: own:m error explain:can:inf while hand still same:m error make:pr
thes_learn_last.exampleAnalysis: i turn of oar_implement:a @:pa. i tell:can:pa why water in my/face rise:pa and still wet:m home return:pa.
thes_learn_last.exampleEnglish: I knew the oar stroke one step ahead of my hands. I could explain why the spray hit my face and still come home wet.
thes_learn_last.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_tactile_signature.label: A maker's touchmark
thes_tactile_signature.meaning: A feature by which its maker or an intimate colleague recognizes a piece of work through handling after visible identifiers have gone
thes_tactile_signature.nativeAnalysis: mark by which hand know:pr who thing make:pa though eye name see:neg:can:pr
thes_tactile_signature.exampleAnalysis: all colour from bowl fade:pp. without look:inf she father:g bowl by @ under edge know:pa.
thes_tactile_signature.exampleEnglish: She knew her father’s bowl by the little rise beneath the rim. Her thumb read his touchmark after all the paint had worn away.
thes_tactile_signature.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_reserve_finish.label: Defer the last stroke
thes_reserve_finish.meaning: To stop with one small finishing act deliberately outstanding because one's present ability to judge it is poorer than it will be later
thes_reserve_finish.nativeAnalysis: one_num last deed while judgment weak:m be:pr leave:inf until well see:can:pr
thes_reserve_finish.exampleAnalysis: only eye of bird which she carve:pp remain:pa. at last light she @:pa and knife down lay:pa.
thes_reserve_finish.exampleEnglish: Only the carved bird’s eye remained. At the last of the light she left that stroke for morning and laid down the knife.
thes_reserve_finish.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_cost_crossing.label: The cost of reaching a price
thes_cost_crossing.meaning: The cost paid solely to get into a position to accept an offer. It already falls on a buyer who travels there and comes home empty
thes_cost_crossing.nativeAnalysis: what to reach offer pay:must:psv:pr even if thing buy:neg:psv:pr
thes_cost_crossing.exampleAnalysis: salt free:m be:pa. @ two day:pl of kjv_row:ev be:pa even for those who no salt find:pa.
thes_cost_crossing.exampleEnglish: The salt itself was free. Two days at the oars was the price of reaching it, even for those who found none.
thes_cost_crossing.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_spent_wind.label: Benefit still arriving from an ended cause
thes_spent_wind.meaning: The portion of a present gain that is still being delivered by support which has already ceased. Its persistence gives no assurance of renewal
thes_spent_wind.nativeAnalysis: good:m thing still receive:psv:pr from help which already cease:perf
thes_spent_wind.exampleAnalysis: last full:m kjv_pot @ of autumn be:pa. field for month:pl empty:m stand:pp.
thes_spent_wind.exampleEnglish: The last full pot was what autumn was still giving us. The fields had stood empty for months.
thes_spent_wind.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_choose_empty.label: Decline after the waiting is spent
thes_choose_empty.meaning: To turn down the first available return once waiting for it has become costly, because taking it would defeat the purpose that made the wait worthwhile
thes_choose_empty.nativeAnalysis: after long:m wait first offer refuse:inf because accept:ev own:m purpose harm:fu
thes_choose_empty.exampleAnalysis: all day buy:ag:pl pass:pa. at evening she offer:a @:pa: that price even thread pay:neg:fu.
thes_choose_empty.exampleEnglish: Buyers had passed all day. At dusk she turned down the first offer she had waited for. It would not even pay for the thread.
thes_choose_empty.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_afterlaugh.label: Laughter that misses its company
thes_afterlaugh.meaning: The pleasure of finally understanding a joke just as one realizes that the people who could share that particular laugh are gone
thes_afterlaugh.nativeAnalysis: joy when old:m jest at last understand:psv:pr and other who it tell:pa away be:pr
thes_afterlaugh.exampleAnalysis: in middle of bay_sea my/@ come:pa. now i know:pa why old:m woman both oar_implement:pl kjv_number:pp. she at wharf_landing be:pa.
thes_afterlaugh.exampleEnglish: Halfway across the bay I finally laughed. Now I understood why the old woman had counted both oars. She was back on the quay.
thes_afterlaugh.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_late_move.label: An answer made possible by defeat
thes_late_move.meaning: A solution that became thinkable because losing exposed which assumption was wrong. Regret over a move one already knew would not earn this word
thes_late_move.nativeAnalysis: answer find:psv:pr because fail:ev show:pr which thought false:m be:pa
thes_late_move.exampleAnalysis: after last piece fall:pa her/@ come:pa. gate she defend:pp be:pa enemy:g way out.
thes_late_move.exampleEnglish: Only after her last piece fell did the answer become visible. The gate she had been guarding was her opponent’s way out.
thes_late_move.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_shared_feint.label: Take the child's invention seriously in play
thes_shared_feint.meaning: To carry forward someone else's imagined action under the constraint they have invented, leaving them the right to decide what counts as true in the game
thes_shared_feint.nativeAnalysis: in play rule which other imagine:pa follow:inf and to other judgment leave:inf
thes_shared_feint.exampleAnalysis: child empty:m cup give:pa. i @:pa and until child say:pa water cool:m be:pr drink:neg:pa.
thes_shared_feint.exampleEnglish: The child handed me an empty cup. I took up her game and waited for her to say the water had cooled before I drank.
thes_shared_feint.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_kind_error.label: Mercy that leaves discovery to the other
thes_kind_error.meaning: The generosity of leaving a real, recoverable opening for someone at a disadvantage, then letting them notice or miss it on their own
thes_kind_error.nativeAnalysis: chance to recover give:inf and where it be:pr show:neg:inf
thes_kind_error.exampleAnalysis: in @ old:m player one_num side open:m leave:pa. child see:neg:pa it and game end:pa.
thes_kind_error.exampleEnglish: Out of this kind of mercy the older player left one side open. The child missed it, and the game ended.
thes_kind_error.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_burden_praise.label: Praise someone into repeating a cost
thes_burden_praise.meaning: To speak admiringly of a freely given act in a way that makes declining a second performance socially costly. The admiration can be sincere
thes_burden_praise.nativeAnalysis: free:m gift praise:inf so next gift refuse:inf shame bring:fu
thes_burden_praise.exampleAnalysis: before ask:ev for other night they keeper:a @:pa for never sleep:ev when wave:pl high:m be:pa.
thes_burden_praise.exampleEnglish: Before asking for another night they praised the keeper for always going sleepless in rough weather. Now she would have to defend going home.
thes_burden_praise.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_credit_place.label: The debt of wearing another's credit
thes_credit_place.meaning: An obligation incurred by discovering that the honour one has accepted belongs to someone else. It begins with discovery even if the original mistake was innocent
thes_credit_place.nativeAnalysis: debt when one_num learn:pr that honour receive:pp for other:g deed
thes_credit_place.exampleAnalysis: i with true:m heart thanks receive:pa. my/@ start:pa when i see:pa whose hand hole close:pp. at feast i stand:pa and her/name say:pa.
thes_credit_place.exampleEnglish: I took the thanks in good faith. My debt began when I saw whose hand had stopped the leak, and at the feast I stood up and named her.
thes_credit_place.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_group_cost.label: A saving passed on as expense
thes_group_cost.meaning: The cost of a service one party has counted as a saving while somebody else must still pay for the service, often afresh on each occasion
thes_group_cost.nativeAnalysis: cost which one_num pay:neg:pr because other same:m work keep:must:pr and again and again pay:must:pr
thes_group_cost.exampleAnalysis: town one_num lamp put out:pa. nightly:m oil in each boat be:pa ourone/@.
thes_group_cost.exampleEnglish: The town saved the cost of one lamp. The oil we now burned in every boat each night was what that saving cost us.
thes_group_cost.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_purpose_blight.label: Cherish past the point of injury
thes_purpose_blight.meaning: To pursue the flourishing of a particular person or thing so possessively that one's care takes away a condition it needs in order to flourish
thes_purpose_blight.nativeAnalysis: in desire other protect:inf what other need:pr take:inf and thus other harm:inf
thes_purpose_blight.exampleAnalysis: boyle_gardener small:m tree:a @:pa. to keep wind from it he around it wall build:pa until tree all day in shade stand:pa.
thes_purpose_blight.exampleEnglish: Wanting the little tree to flourish, the gardener walled out the wind so completely that the tree spent the whole day in shade.
thes_purpose_blight.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_spend_own_seat.label: Pay with one's future capacity to enjoy
thes_spend_own_seat.meaning: To want an end enough to surrender the very faculty or relationship through which attaining it would have mattered. The pursuer bears the principal loss
thes_spend_own_seat.nativeAnalysis: for desired:m end lose:inf own:m means by which its/joy receive:can:psv:pr
thes_spend_own_seat.exampleAnalysis: for honour of sing:ev at feast he @:pa. night after night he sing:pa until on feast day voice fail:pa and only hear:can:pa.
thes_spend_own_seat.exampleEnglish: He wanted the honour of singing at the feast so badly that he spent his voice earning it. On the feast day he could only listen.
thes_spend_own_seat.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_export_risk.label: Pursue at an unconsulted person's risk
thes_export_risk.meaning: To want a result enough to settle uncertainty by passing the exposure to someone outside the undertaking. The third party has neither chosen the aim nor shared in its reward
thes_export_risk.nativeAnalysis: for own:m desired:m end danger to other give:inf who this end choose:neg:pa and in gain no share receive:pr
thes_export_risk.exampleAnalysis: for first:m sell:ev trader @:pa. own:m cloth under roof put:pa and neighbour:g seed in rain leave:pa.
thes_export_risk.exampleEnglish: Wanting the first sale, the trader put his cloth under cover and left the neighbour’s seed in the rain.
thes_export_risk.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_home_self.label: A home one is still learning to inhabit again
thes_home_self.meaning: A place where one's welcome has been restored before the habits of exile or exclusion have relaxed. It ceases to bear this word when ease of belonging returns
thes_home_self.nativeAnalysis: home where person who return:perf welcome receive:perf but still as stranger live:pr
thes_home_self.exampleAnalysis: in her/@ sister her/key back give:pp. still each night before enter:ev she knock:pa.
thes_home_self.exampleEnglish: Her sister had returned her key. For weeks it was still the kind of home where she knocked each night before going in.
thes_home_self.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_borrow_rule.label: A measure lent by a body
thes_borrow_rule.meaning: A temporary standard supplied by another person's gesture or reach, valid while the learner finds a repeatable measure of their own
thes_borrow_rule.nativeAnalysis: other:g hand as measure until pupil_student own:m measure know:pr
thes_borrow_rule.exampleAnalysis: for first three kjv_loop:pl my/thumb_digit her/@ be:pa. fourth she by her/own:m finger make:pa.
thes_borrow_rule.exampleEnglish: For the first three loops my thumb was her borrowed measure. The fourth she sized with her own finger.
thes_borrow_rule.origin: New compound coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_asked_silence.label: A silence someone else is relying on
thes_asked_silence.meaning: The positive obligation to leave another person's interval open long enough for their work or words to arrive. It can be discharged only by how one times one's own entrance
thes_asked_silence.nativeAnalysis: duty to wait so other:g word or work its/place have:pr
thes_asked_silence.exampleAnalysis: as child her/first:m name read:pa i my/@ keep:pa. last sign she by self sound:pa.
thes_asked_silence.exampleEnglish: While the child read her first name I kept the silence I owed her. She sounded the last sign herself.
thes_asked_silence.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_untested_inheritance.label: The duty to leave a check still possible
thes_untested_inheritance.meaning: A departing guide's obligation to let a successor compare a first independent judgment against a still-available reference. Merely handing over the conclusion leaves the duty outstanding
thes_untested_inheritance.nativeAnalysis: duty of one_num who depart:fu: leave other means own:m judgment test:inf
thes_untested_inheritance.exampleAnalysis: keeper:g @ endure:pa one_num more night. child by star steer_course:pa while he old:m course in mind keep:pa.
thes_untested_inheritance.exampleEnglish: The keeper owed one more night. The child steered by the star while he kept the old course in mind for comparison.
thes_untested_inheritance.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_wash_first.label: Talk a shared silence clear
thes_wash_first.meaning: To spend the first exchange after an estrangement on things both speakers can answer freely, until a harder subject can enter by consent
thes_wash_first.nativeAnalysis: after long:m silence both about easy:m thing speak:pr until both freely hard:m thing say:can:pr
thes_wash_first.exampleAnalysis: about broken:m gate wepl @:pa. when damei_tea cold:m be:pa she herself father:g name say:pa.
thes_wash_first.exampleEnglish: We talked about the broken gate until the long silence between us had eased. When the tea was cold she brought up Father herself.
thes_wash_first.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_release_judgment.label: Hold one judgment open for a person
thes_release_judgment.meaning: To let a new deed count on its own terms while retaining what one knows of the person's conduct. Neither forgetting the past nor granting full trust is required
thes_release_judgment.nativeAnalysis: former:m deed:pl remember:inf and new:m deed by itself judge:inf
thes_release_judgment.exampleAnalysis: after debt:pl she still key to he give:neg:pa. yet when he widow help:pa she @:pa and he:a thank:pa.
thes_release_judgment.exampleEnglish: She still kept the key after those debts. When he helped the widow, she let that deed count and thanked him for it.
thes_release_judgment.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.

thes_consented_limit.label: Agree with one's own wish still audible
thes_consented_limit.meaning: To choose a shared course after each person has made their separate preference known, including where the preferences differ. Quiet compliance does not constitute the act
thes_consented_limit.nativeAnalysis: both own:m wish say:pr then one_num common:m way choose:inf
thes_consented_limit.exampleAnalysis: i bay_sea prefer:pa and she river prefer:pa. after both speak:pa wepl @:pa to river go:inf.
thes_consented_limit.exampleEnglish: I wanted the bay and she wanted the river. Once both wishes were heard, we chose the river together.
thes_consented_limit.origin: New stem coined in the Vayrshemon Thesaurus.
